newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Riksbank drains 16 bln SKR from the market.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Riksbank drains 16 bln SKR from the market.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, said on Tuesday it drained 16 billion crowns from the market in its weekly reverse repurchase operation.
The reverse repo was set at an unchanged fixed rate of 4.10 percent and will run from January 29 to February 5, replacing an operation that drained 20 billion crowns from the market.
The Riksbank said 3.60 percent of the bids for the tender were allocated.
